content: Telemedicine consultations are available for follow-up visits, minor ailments, medication reviews, and general health queries where a physical examination is not clinically required. New patients seeking telemedicine must first complete an in-person registration appointment so that the clinic can verify identity and establish a baseline medical record. Telemedicine sessions are conducted via the clinic's secure video platform; patients need a smartphone or computer with a working camera, microphone, and stable internet connection. Certain specialties—including Orthopedics requiring physical assessment and procedures requiring on-site equipment—are not available via telemedicine. Telemedicine appointments can be booked through the clinic portal 24 hours a day; the same cancellation and rescheduling policy applies as for in-person appointments.
